title: GNSS/INS EKF through a GNSS outage and a spoofing walk-off
summary: A stdlib-only 2D loosely-coupled GNSS/INS EKF (8 states, hand-written matrix helpers) on a synthetic vehicle with biased, noisy 100 Hz IMU and 1 Hz GNSS. It compares INS-only, EKF, EKF with a chi-square innovation gate, and a gated EKF that latches into holdover through a 60 s outage and a slowly walking spoofed offset. A sweep shows that the gate catches fast walk-offs but misses slow ones.
verified: ran with python3.14.7 stdlib on 2026-11-06 (default run and --sweep), output shown in README. filterpy_crosscheck.py re-ran both with filterpy 2.0.0's ExtendedKalmanFilter doing covariance, innovation and Joseph-form update (Python 3.12.14) and reproduced the tables to the printed 0.1 m; inflating R 100x in the filterpy path changed them, so that path is live. gnss-ins-sim, KF-GINS and GTSAM were not run.
